note: Joint bands to trim, each checked against its own plate with renders/overlay-one.mjs. NOT A RULE: a joint may legitimately come in many bands far apart — the knuckles are one band each, the knee has a medial and a lateral compartment, the costovertebral joints run the length of the thorax — so anything automatic that dropped 'small and far' rings destroyed those. An entry here says a human looked at the picture and the ring is not the joint.

trims.why: Three specks over the metatarsal shafts and bases, a quarter of the frame distal to the Chopart line. The joint itself is the two bands over the talonavicular and calcaneocuboid gaps, which are adjacent and stay.
